newsitem.title: CHINA: INDIA STEEL AUTHORITY SETS $85MLN LOAN.
newsitem.headline: INDIA STEEL AUTHORITY SETS $85MLN LOAN.

text.p: The following syndicated loan was announced by arranger Sumitomo Bank.
BORROWER STEEL AUTHORITY OF INDIA LTD
AMOUNT US$85 MLN TYPE TERM LOAN MATURITY 8 YRS
MARGIN LIBOR+54BP DRAWDOWN MULTIPLE LAUNCHED 08.AUG.97
AVAIL 3 MTHS FROM THE SIGNING DATE OF THE FACILITY
REPAYMENT THREE EQUAL ANNUAL INSTALMENTS COMMENCING SIX
YEARS' FROM DATE OF FIRST DRAWING
HOME CTRY INDIA GOV LAW ENGLISH
ARRANGER SUMITOMO BANK (AGENT)
MGT LEVELS AND FEES
ARRANGERS US$10-14.999 MLN 37.5BP
CO-ARRANGERS US$6-9.999 MLN 35.0BP
LEAD MANAGERS US$3-5.999 MLN 30.0BP
MANAGERS US$1-2.999 MLN 20.0BP
NOTES PREPAYMENT OF THE WHOLE OR ANY PORTION OF THE FACILITY
IS PERMITTED IN MINIMUM AMOUNTS OF US$10 MLN AND
INTEGRAL MULTIPLES OF US$1 MLN THEREAFTER ON ANY
INTEREST PERIOD DATE. AMOUNTS PREPAID CANNOT BE
REBORROWED. THERE IS A 51 PCT OWNERSHIP MAINTAINENANCE
CLAUSE FOR GOVERNMENT OF INDIA. PROCEEDS WILL BE USED
FOR CAPITAL EXPENDITURE AND GENERAL CORPORATE FUNDING.
